already_present: Original native task/claim/grant admission, independent nomination replay, Portal/worktree/lifecycle custody and exact one-use reader publication are separate existing owners. Preserve their literal retained objects and fail-closed joins.

WorkerSourceBroker is an existing, different semantic-view broker wired through OWNER_ENTRY/OWNER_MONITOR; it creates no typed native source.get authority. Do not merge these broker identities or implement another source-view launcher.

The deployed worker entry already has separate nonroot UID, root-controlled boundary, capabilities/no-new-privileges checks, a scrubbed environment and protected owner authorities. Their implementations exist; current native source host fixtures do not execute and qualify that complete chain.

Signed profile replay, required raw supports/program roles, canonical context chunks, task bundle selection, owner sealed prompt handoff and router dispatch rechecks already exist. Reuse their independent checks instead of trusting serialized verified flags.

asset_preservation.rule: Preserve existing embeddings, source spans, inventories, separate DuckDB/DuckLake owners, checkpoints and registrations/repositories. This bridge does not load, merge, rename, upload, train, distill, benchmark or promote any model or decoder asset.

concrete_gaps.observation: OWNER_ENTRY performs 3770/2770 directory and 660/770 source provisioning after the native allocation can have been captured. _directory rejects group/world writes, and even an otherwise safe later chmod changes retained mode/ctime custody. Existing handles cannot be normalized, recaptured or patched to accept it.

concrete_gaps.next_scope: Reuse the existing private finite-proof dispatch architecture for an explicitly source-scoped authenticated handoff; do not accept finite-proof authorization as source authority and do not broaden the legacy direct-child lane.
concrete_gaps.observation: The original Quack owner, bootstrapped native daemon, owner wrapper and wrapper-launched sudo/worker are different roles. _note_native_spawned requires a Popen direct child of the current broker owner. The wrapper cannot serialize a Popen/PID to make that child belong to the Quack process.

concrete_gaps.next_scope: Require an owner-derived correspondence retaining all distinct identities, derived from existing admitted live context/compiled artifact and signed source replay. A caller-selected mapping, a digest-shaped native CID, task equality alone or a copied accepted Boolean cannot establish the join.
concrete_gaps.observation: The native descriptor has owner-admitted context_cid/repository_id/source_binding_cid. The source formalization handoff separately pins a task bundle artifact+SHA and actual prompt/evidence bytes; signed Terminal scope separately authenticates full inputs and selected roles. The router deliberately does not alias these identifiers. The reviewed files do not show one source-specific owner admission that independently joins all three to the same native generation and authenticated wrapper child.

Admit successor inventory/nomination/context/grants through existing authorized transitions; no continuing source.get grant over arbitrary dirty source and no implied physical filesystem confinement.
later_writable_delegation_not_in_next_in.rule: Preserve the prior permission-handoff-design proposal. minimal_gating_regression.baseline_rule: First establish the existing behavior at the actual new composition point. An absent source-specific integration/API is an explicit unsupported-path result, not a fabricated authorization bypass or a passing safety test. Preserve raw baseline before implementing the gate.
minimal_gating_regression.description: Compose a real native task/claim/allocation and genuine signed public source scope with two independently valid compiled context selections for the same task/source baseline. Bind expected context A through its actual owner admission, supply prompt/bundle B or a missing owner correspondence at the source launch gate, and require refusal before child preparation/publication. Keeping the task, repository, source bytes and valid individual signatures equal makes the independent context mismatch decisive.
required_observations: No Popen/provider/model/solver or source RPC; no newly admitted source grant/socket/descriptor/thread for the refused composed launch.

Existing native task/allocation/nomination objects and bind-once reader publication remain exact, consumed where already published; no replacement handles, forged guard classes, copied authority Booleans or patching witnesses.
A matching A selection passes the gate using actual existing validators, without starting a provider; mandatory task/acceptance/raw-support bodies remain present.
minimal_gating_regression.test_separation: Use a structural signed compiled capsule without learned/model receipts for this gate. New actual separate-UID/daemon/bootstrap deployment qualification is a later bounded inert-process test and must retain its own evidence; authored routing seams cannot satisfy it.

minimal_next_increment.name: Read-only native source launch admission with independent compiled-context correspondence
ordering: Resolve the existing bootstrapped native owner/daemon and independently admitted command/context using current trust owners. Do not discover new authority from worker inputs or sender-selected database/sidecar paths.

Provision only the reviewed read-only UID/GID/group traversal profile before native allocation capture. Retain original control/source witnesses; leave the existing writable owner-wrapper branch unavailable to this native source profile.

As owner, replay the actual signed declaration and complete input population through existing signature/source validators; verify selected paths, required raw support, program paths and the full omitted frontier. Independently replay the compiled task/context selection and exact sealed prompt bytes. Retain literal native task/allocation/nomination objects and distinct source/context/bundle/manifest identities.

Close source-specific admission with original task revision/full body/claim/grant, allocation lifecycle/lease, source inventory/nomination generation, actual context bytes and descriptor/prompt correspondence. Reject absent correspondence rather than inferring context identity from bundle SHA, repository path or selected filenames.

Only after that gate, prepare a source-specific private handoff between the original owner and genuine daemon/wrapper. Independently observe kernel peers, exact bootstrapped daemon argv and derived attempt sidecar, selected wrapper command/cwd and their births. The runtime run lease and native task attempt coordinator remain separate.

At the wrapper literal Popen boundary, retain its real child and acknowledge the actual selected worker descendant UID/birth/cwd through that authenticated channel. Keep direct-owner SourceLookupWorkerBroker registration as a separate strict existing lane; never adopt arbitrary PID metadata or broaden ancestry.

Recheck the same native/context/source/deployment custody after supported callbacks and before acknowledgement or reply publication. Use COOR-before-SERVER; keep retained CAS and source-specific callbacks outside SERVER. Define only the finite callback points explicitly qualified by the follow-up tests.

Pre-birth refusal publishes no admitted child and prevents Popen. After-birth refusal consumes only its own handoff, retires its exact source grant/endpoints and preserves incurred validated native accounting; the literal spawning caller terminates/reaps its actual child. No retry, legacy downgrade or model fallback may manufacture admission.
minimal_next_increment.protocol_rule: No new capability is issued by this proposal. A future source handoff requires its own reviewed versioned protocol on the existing owners and independently admitted command; finite-proof, source-view, native source and sealed formalization schemas keep their current distinct meanings.
